import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
class Item { const Item(this.id); final String? id; }
class P extends StatelessWidget {
 const P({required this.items}); final List<Item> items;
 @override Widget build(BuildContext context)=>LayoutBuilder(builder:(outer,box)=>GridView.builder(
  primary:false,
  gridDelegate:const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(crossAxisCount:2,mainAxisExtent:40),
  itemCount:items.length,
  itemBuilder:(_,index)=>null,
  findChildIndexCallback:(key)=>items.indexWhere((item) {
    final same=item.id==(key as ValueKey<String?>).value;
    return same && Theme.of(outer).brightness==Brightness.light && MediaQuery.sizeOf(outer).width>100;
  })));
}
